Two indexes are declared, and the sort-key rivalry below is inside the second
one alone. A sort key files a term in its own index only, so the report of a
rivalry has to say which index the two keys are rivals in — the same term in
the other index is a different entry with a filing of its own.

The first index carries one term, and no mark of it writes a sort key:
[Quokka]{.index}.

The second index carries one term, marked twice, and the two marks write
different sort keys for it: [Ptarmigan]{.index index="authors" sort="Zebra"}
and [Ptarmigan]{.index index="authors" sort="Yak"}. The first key wins and the
second cannot apply as well, so the mistake is reported.

No mark here writes a cross-reference target, so this document draws no
dangling-target report of either shape.
